# Filmorax

> Filmorax is the cinematic and advertising production arm of influUGC, a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. It produces commercials, brand films, cinematic content, product videos, event coverage and full post-production for brands in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf — from concept and script through the shoot to final delivery in every platform format.

## Services (Production)

- Commercial Production: commercials for TV and digital platforms — concept, script, casting, direction, cinematography and masters in all sizes.
- Brand Films: short cinematic films that tell the brand's story for launches, occasions and company channels.
- Cinematic Social Content: reels and short videos with film-grade lighting, photography and grading, in social platform sizes and rhythms.
- Product Videos: detailed product showcase, real usage footage and short performance cuts for e-commerce and advertising.
- Event Coverage: multi-camera filming of openings, launches and events, aerial footage when needed, and event aftermovies.
- Post-Production: editing, colour grading, sound design and mixing, motion graphics, subtitling and localisation, with delivery in every platform's versions and sizes.

## Guides (free, on the landing pages)

Published on the homepages (Arabic: https://filmorax.com/#guides · English: https://filmorax.com/en.html#guides) — practical know-how from how production actually runs:

- How to write a production brief for a commercial (https://filmorax.com/en.html#guide-brief): the brief is what the shoot is priced, cast and scheduled from. It needs one objective, the audience and final placements (which decide formats and durations), the single message, what must be shown about the product and the claims as legal allows them, tone references (not frame-by-frame templates), and a scope page: the full deliverables list, expected days and locations, talent needs, the live date and exactly who approves at treatment, casting and final cut.
- What a one-day shoot actually involves (https://filmorax.com/en.html#guide-shoot): a shoot day is a temporary factory of around twelve working hours — setup and lighting before any filming, a full crew (direction and production, camera and light, sound, art department, wardrobe and makeup, cast, catering), a schedule ordered by location and daylight under a call sheet, and at wrap you hold backed-up raw material, not a film; the film is built in post, which is why shoot days and post days are quoted separately.
- Video usage rights for ads, explained (https://filmorax.com/en.html#guide-rights): production payment is not ownership of every use. Separate the edited film from the talent's image rights (faces and voices licensed per media, territory and duration). A usage agreement defines media (TV, digital/social, out-of-home, in-store, cinema), territory, duration from first air plus renewal, and category exclusivity; library music and stock footage carry their own licence terms. Agree usage in writing before casting — renegotiating after a successful campaign costs far more.
